summary.decision: Pottier et al. 2023 Pseudomonas aeruginosa DDAC is the only currently identified non-Listeria, pharma-relevant, supervised-ML candidate with both phenotype and public-sequence evidence reported. Bcc studies are high biological priority but require strain-to-genome verification before modeling.

studies.pharma_water_relevance: High: opportunistic water-system organism; hospital/environmental relevance
studies.phenotype_evidence: DDAC MICs reported for a 100-strain random panel; decreased susceptibility threshold MIC > 62.9 mg/L reported.
studies.genome_evidence: Article reports WGS for 77 strains and public BioProject PRJNA884650.
studies.accession_or_project: PRJNA884650; reference genomes CP015117, ASWV01000001, GCF_000504485.1, GCA_000006765.1
studies.recommended_next_action: Download figshare/data supplement, map strain IDs to PRJNA884650 assemblies, and build a DDAC labeled manifest only from rows with both MIC/DS label and sequence accession.
studies.caution: Do not assume all 100 phenotyped strains have WGS; verify row-level strain/accession mapping first.

studies.citation_short: Wang et al. 2015, Applied Microbiology and Biotechnology
studies.pharma_water_relevance: High: Bcc contamination risk in antiseptics/disinfectants and water-based pharmaceutical products
studies.phenotype_evidence: MICs for 36 BCC strains following exposure to CHX and BZK solutions.
studies.genome_evidence: No public WGS/accession set confirmed from abstract-level evidence.
studies.recommended_next_action: Extract strain list from the article/supplement and query NCBI/ENA/Assembly by exact strain names; use only matched public genomes.
studies.caution: Good pharma relevance, but not supervised-ML ready until genome accessions are verified.

studies.citation_short: Rushton et al. 2013, Antimicrobial Agents and Chemotherapy
studies.pharma_water_relevance: High: industrial and preservative contamination relevance
studies.biocide_endpoint: Industrial preservatives including benzalkonium chloride and isothiazolinones
studies.phenotype_evidence: Preservative susceptibility/adaptive resistance profiling across Bcc panels; study describes 60 industrial isolates and an 83-strain profiling panel.
studies.genome_evidence: MLST/microarray/transcriptomic evidence reported, but public isolate-level WGS accessions are not confirmed.
studies.accession_or_project: Bcc MLST records reported; no WGS BioProject confirmed
studies.recommended_next_action: Use as Bcc phenotype source only if strain names can be mapped to public assemblies; otherwise cite as mechanistic/context evidence.
studies.caution: Panel size is attractive, but genome availability is the deciding bottleneck.

studies.pharma_water_relevance: High: explicitly motivated by pharmaceutical-product contamination
studies.phenotype_evidence: Survival, inactivation/degradation, proteomic and metabolic evidence for intrinsic BZK resistance.
studies.genome_evidence: Mechanistic/proteomic focus; not identified as an isolate-level WGS+MIC cohort.
studies.recommended_next_action: Use for biological rationale and interpretation of Bcc candidates, not for training unless strain-level labels and genomes are recovered.
studies.caution: Do not convert mechanism statements into binary isolate labels.

studies.citation_short: Chittrakanwong et al. 2021, Canadian Journal of Microbiology
studies.pharma_water_relevance: Medium-high: opportunistic water-associated organism and hospital-environment persistence relevance
studies.phenotype_evidence: Adaptive BAC protection mediated by mfsQ; mutant showed increased susceptibility.
studies.genome_evidence: Gene-level mechanistic study rather than public isolate cohort.
studies.recommended_next_action: Use as target-gene interpretation for S. maltophilia candidate regions, especially MFS/QAC neighborhoods.

studies.citation_short: Moore et al. 2009, Journal of Antimicrobial Chemotherapy
studies.organism_group: Bcc plus non-Bcc controls including Pseudomonas, Ralstonia, Stenotrophomonas
studies.pharma_water_relevance: Medium-high: includes Bcc and water/pharma-relevant non-fermenters
studies.biocide_endpoint: Triclosan, povidone, benzalkonium chloride and related biocide susceptibility measures
studies.phenotype_evidence: Biocide susceptibility assessed by broth dilution MIC, MBC screens, and suspension tests; includes 24 P. aeruginosa controls and single Ralstonia/Stenotrophomonas controls.
studies.genome_evidence: No public WGS/accession set confirmed; older phenotype panel.
studies.recommended_next_action: Use for background and possible strain-name search, but do not treat single non-Bcc controls as organism-level benchmarks.
studies.caution: Insufficient confirmed genome linkage for ML; Ralstonia evidence is especially sparse.

studies.pharma_water_relevance: Comparator only: food-safety organism, not pharma-water organism
studies.phenotype_evidence: Large WGS+MIC benchmark; BC tolerance threshold >= 1.25 mg/L; best BC classification BA 0.97 +/- 0.02.
studies.genome_evidence: Public supplemental accessions and independent validation sets reported.
studies.accession_or_project: Supplementary tables and public genome accessions
studies.recommended_next_action: Keep as comparator and labeled validation anchor; do not use it as pharma-water phenotype evidence.
studies.caution: Strong benchmark, but organism/domain mismatch for pharmaceutical water.
